chunks: And by this chain, from Hafs who said:

I saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) walking through the gardens of Kufa. He came to a palm tree, performed ablution near it, then bowed and prostrated. I counted in his prostration five hundred glorifications. Then he leaned against the palm tree and supplicated with supplications. Then he said: 'O Abu Hafs! By Allah, it is the palm tree about which Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said to Maryam (peace be upon her): And shake towards you the trunk of the palm tree, it will drop on you fresh ripe dates.'

key_terms.بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ: by the trunk of the palm tree

ai.seo_question: Which palm tree is identified in Shia hadith as the one mentioned in the Quranic story of Maryam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) demonstrates the virtue of specific locations for prayer by performing ablution and prostrating near a palm tree in Kufa, reciting five hundred glorifications. He identifies this tree as the miraculous one mentioned in the Quran where God commanded Maryam to shake its trunk to receive fresh dates, linking physical space with divine blessing. This narration highlights the Shia belief in the spiritual significance of natural elements and places associated with Quranic events.
